function.name: REALLOC
function.param: Pointer to a memory zone reserved in a previous calling of
Size in bytes of the memory zone reserved
function.abstract: It increases or reduces the reserved space of a memory block

description.p: REALLOC increases or reduces the reserved space of a memory block. The function receives two parameters: the first must be the pointer returned by once time reserved the block, the second will be the new size that must have the memory block.

REALLOC can change the location of the memory block if it was necessary. REALLOC will return a pointer at the beginning of the new memory block, which must be used instead of the previous pointer returned by ALLOC, that it will not be valid.

All data of the original block will be stored in the new block, but the part of the data, which can not be stored, will not be stored in that block, and if the new size is higher, then the additional memory zone can hold random values or previous values used before, so it is responsability of the programmer to initialize that zone with the correct values.
